name: Yuzu Hanasaki
source:
One of the souls trapped within the Mirror World. Unlike the melancholic Mishiro, Yuzu displays a cheerful, lively, and friendly demeanor, acting as an energetic companion from the very beginning. She actively encourages Mishiro to find the truth about her past.

[spoiler]In reality, Yuzu ended up committing suicide by drowning near Mirror Lake due to the psychological pressure and bullying. She keeps her tragic past hidden while secretly searching for Utsuro Hinohara.[/spoiler]
